claim_boundary: ACCEPTED_BOUNDED_CAPABILITY only; active diagnostic input selection over an existing finite executable repository-patch version space, not independent candidate generation, open-ended/stateful/effectful test invention, general repository coding, unrestricted program synthesis, or AGI.
critical_unknowns: R2.60 can only discriminate hypotheses that already exist in the supplied executable candidate version space; missing-target recovery and independent candidate generation are not established.

Legal probe domains remain finite and host-provided, and RepositoryProbe currently represents positional JSON-scalar inputs rather than stateful, temporal, filesystem, network, concurrency, dependency or other effectful experiments.
The pinned NumPy transfer uses an independently sourced I/O oracle but a host-authored four-hypothesis candidate ecology, so hypothesis-generation independence is not established.
The authored six-episode repository family inherits the R2.52 generator and may contain family-specific regularities despite target-output-free probe selection and candidate identity invariance.
Terminal safety currently relies on exhaustive verification: 2,401 oracle calls per authored accepted episode and 625 on the NumPy transfer, so total oracle-call efficiency is not demonstrated.
Independent challengers, adversarial fresh repositories, counterfactual representation families and broad issue-resolution evidence remain insufficient for W5 convergence.
